uxbridge.translation: 阿克斯布里奇（美国、加拿大、英国地名）\n乌克斯桥（英国地名）

uxo.translation: abbr. unexploded ordnance 未爆炸的军火

uxor.definition: n (legal terminology) the Latin word for wife

uxorial.definition: a. Dotingly fond of, or servilely submissive to, a wife;\n   uxorious; also, becoming a wife; pertaining to a wife.

uxoricidal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to uxoricide; tending to uxoricide.
uxoricidal.translation: [法] 杀妻的, 犯杀妻罪的

uxoricide.definition: n. a husband who murders his wife\nn. the murder of a wife by her husband
uxoricide.translation: n. 杀妻, 杀妻者\n[法] 杀妻, 杀妻者, 杀妻罪

uxorilocal.translation: a. (人类学用语)(婚后)居住在女方的,入赘风俗的

uxorious.definition: s. foolishly fond of or submissive to your wife
uxorious.translation: a. 溺爱妻子的, 一味顺从妻子的, 怕老婆的\n[法] 对妻子过分宠爱的, 怕老婆的

uxoriously.definition: r in a loving and uxorious manner
uxoriously.translation: adv. 疼爱妻子地, 顺从妻子地

uxoriousness.definition: n. foolish fondness for or excessive submissiveness to one's wife
